name: Heirloom Rainbow Tomatoes
description: Sweet, deeply aromatic vine-ripened tomatoes grown from non-hybrid heritage seeds without synthetic pesticides.
nutrition: Rich in Lycopene, Vitamin C, Vitamin K, and Potassium.
storageTip: Store at room temperature stem-side down; refrigeration damages delicate floral flavors.

name: Organic Honeycrisp & Gala Apples
description: Ultra-crisp, explosive sweet-tart apples freshly harvested from family orchard groves.
nutrition: High dietary fiber (pectin), Vitamin C, and polyphenolic antioxidants.
storageTip: Keep in the crisper drawer of your refrigerator at 32-35°F to stay crisp for up to 6 weeks.

name: Hydroponic Tuscan Lacinato Kale
description: Tender, deeply pigmented dark green dinosaur kale leaves with an earthy, slightly sweet profile.
nutrition: Powerhouse of Vitamin A, C, K, Iron, and Calcium.
storageTip: Wrap stems in damp paper towel and seal loosely in a reusable produce bag.

name: Wild Spring Strawberries & Blackberries
description: Intensely fragrant berry varieties picked at peak morning ripeness with unrivaled natural sweetness.
nutrition: Anthocyanins, Vitamin C, Manganese, and Folate.
storageTip: Do not wash until immediately before eating. Store in single layer on paper towels in the fridge.

name: Fresh Sweet Genovese Basil
description: Pungent, vibrant aromatic herb essential for homemade pesto, caprese salads, and pasta sauces.
nutrition: Essential oils (eugenol, linalool), Vitamin K, and beta-carotene.
storageTip: Treat like a bouquet of cut flowers: trim stems and place in a jar of water at room temperature.

name: Pasture-Raised Organic Farm Eggs
description: Rich golden-orange yolks from hens foraging freely on clover pastures, certified humane and organic.
nutrition: Omega-3 fatty acids, Choline, complete protein, Vitamin B12.
storageTip: Keep in their original carton in the main body of the refrigerator, not the door.

name: Raw Wildflower Blossom Honey
description: Unheated, unfiltered raw honey capturing regional flora pollen notes from local beehives.
nutrition: Enzymes, bioactive antioxidants, amino acids, and pollen trace minerals.
storageTip: Store tightly closed at room temperature in a dry cupboard. If crystallized, gently warm in warm water.

name: Wild Forest Foraged Chanterelles & Morels
description: Delicately fragrant wild golden chanterelles and specialty cultivated oyster and shiitake mushrooms.
nutrition: High in Vitamin D, B-vitamins, Selenium, and ergothioneine.
storageTip: Store in a brown paper bag in the vegetable compartment; never store in airtight plastic bags.
